title: Banking test split, gated arm after the rules designed from it (2026-11-03; tuned, in-sample)
note: τ²'s 20 banking test tasks, k=2, the gated tools arm only, on the code with every fix on (main at 7bf75cb, #29-#45). Its alone column is the 2026-11-02 alone arm of the run below: a cross-day comparison, and the alone arm was not rerun. Tuned and in-sample: The rules of #29-#44 were designed from this split's 2026-11-02 gated run, so the split is design data and no held-out banking test result is possible from here on. Passes 11/40 vs alone's 7/40, by task 3 better, 0 worse (sign test p = 0.25, two-sided); may be chance. Against τ²'s offline re-grade of the alone arm (10/40), 3 better, 1 worse (sign test p = 0.63, two-sided). Not re-graded. Step-limit endings 6 (the 2026-11-02 gated arm: 14). The gate refused 40 writes; 25 refused a write τ² expects, and 4 of those 25 were false against gold (request, verification once x2, closure reason). Glimmer on Modal.

title: Banking test split, every write gated (2026-11-02; design data for #29-#44)
note: τ²'s 20 banking test tasks, k=2, Glimmer alone vs Glimmer with the gates and decision tools, on the code after #20-#25 (the request record, the retention answer, the savings interest rules). Some debit rules were written from this split's failures on 2026-10-28, and every conversation of this run was then read: The rules of #29-#44 were designed from this split's 2026-11-02 gated run, so the split is design data and no held-out banking test result is possible from here on. Passes 7/40 vs 7/40 (by task 2 better, 2 worse). Writes that differ from τ²'s expected ones: 34 alone vs 25 gated, extra writes 13 vs 4 (by task 5 fewer, 2 more; may be chance); wrong values 21 vs 21. 14 gated runs hit τ²'s step limit (10 knowledge-base search loops, 4 with request-record refusals); alone had 7 context overflows. Glimmer on Modal.

title: Banking, 59 unseen tasks, gates plus the search fix (tuned on their failures)
note: The same 59 tasks and seeds, k=2, the gated tools arm only, on the code after PR 158-174: the v10 fixes and the search fix of PR 171, which was designed after reading these tasks' step-limit failures, so the set is tuned on them. Its alone column is banking-unseen-gated's Glimmer-alone arm. No gain: on the old gated arm's 108 matched runs, 14 passed with the fix vs 19 before, and the step limit was hit in 34 vs 41; what keeps these runs searching is not established. Glimmer on Modal.

title: Banking, 59 unseen tasks, write gates enforced
note: The 59 banking training tasks outside the 12 the gates were built on, whose correct answers make a gated write; no gate, plan or tool change came from their runs. k=2, Glimmer on Modal, gated tools arm on the code at PR 151 (before the search fix of PR 171). No gain: 5 tasks better, 8 worse (sign test p = 0.58, two-sided); task_064 is no data because every run in both arms overflowed. Alone's misses include 30 context overflows; the gated arm hit τ²'s step limit in 41 of 108 runs (cause likely, not tested). The gate refused 21 writes: 0 false (6 refused a write τ² expects until a required step was done); the other 15 refused writes τ² does not expect and are not judged.

title: Banking, untuned tasks, write gates enforced (v9)
note: Tasks 050 and 053, which no gate, plan or open-item change came from. 053's failures are likely the simulated customer's answers (not checked); two tasks cannot reach p < 0.05 by a two-sided sign test. Eight earlier reported gated versions are in docs/results.md; v9 is the latest, and every version is compared with one baseline draw. Later changes (PR 148, PR 149: refusal wording and which requests count as a credit limit increase) are not in this run. k=4. Glimmer on Modal.

note: τ²'s 20 banking test tasks, first read on 2026-10-28, then untouched. title: Retail and airline, held-out tasks (current tools)
note: A fresh random draw of 10 retail and 10 airline tasks, excluding the design tasks, the whole failure inventory and the first draw; no tool change came from these tasks. Run on the current tools. By task: 2 improved, 14 tied, 4 worse (sign test p = 0.69, two-sided); on retail 0 improved and 3 worse. 2 of the 5 retail failures with the tools were caused by find_variants matching option names as exact strings. k=4. Glimmer on Modal.

title: Retail and airline, first held-out draw (now design data)
